cohort: Neonates aged 3 to 28 days admitted to the Jimma University Medical Center neonatal ward who stayed for at least 48 hours.
finding: Effective prevention of neonatal nosocomial infections (NNIs) could reduce neonatal mortality and hospital stays, with urinary catheterization, surgical procedures, and longer hospital stays identified as increasing NNI risk.
followup_time: Average duration of hospital stay of 14.6 days for neonates admitted between 3 and 28 days of age.
birth_weight: Included neonates, with 31.4% of patients being underweight at birth.
gest_age: Included neonates, with 33% of infected patients being born prematurely.
